title: キタサンブラック登場！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black is an Umamusume born to a legendary enka singer whom she greatly respects. Her dream is to race on huge stages and to bring a smile to everyone just like her father.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her rival is Satono Diamond. When they were younger, the two promised to race in the Classic Triple Crown together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She idolizes Tokai Teio and hopes to reach her full potential and be just like her idol someday.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And now, Kitasan Black and I are going to take on the Twinkle Series!
